result.reason: The revision reaches the fallback position by imposing a mutual 12-month-fee cap and uncapping at least indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence, and wilful misconduct; it also adds the preferred data/security, fraud, and IP carve-outs and appropriately excludes Client payment obligations. The changes are targeted and preserve the clause’s core risk-allocation purpose. It does not reach the preferred position because it omits the USD 1,000,000 floor and a mutual indirect/consequential-damages exclusion. Drafting is generally professional, though the 12-month period should be expressly anchored to the claim, and “fees” would be clearer than compensation limited to Hosting and Support Services.
